customManagers.description: The browser tests (ci.yml) and axe (lighthouse.yml) run in Microsoft's Playwright image, pinned by tag and digest in a job env var that the github-actions manager does not read.
ci.yml lints the workflows with actionlint and zizmor from images pinned by tag and digest in step env vars, which the github-actions manager does not read.

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot apply minimumReleaseAge to Bun lock refreshes, so its stability check would stay pending and hold the automerge. bunfig.toml's install.minimumReleaseAge enforces the same 7-day wait while Bun regenerates the lockfile.
Hold @types/node to the Node major that production and CI run (26). Raise in lockstep with .nvmrc and engines.node.
A Node major moves .nvmrc and engines.node, which Vercel resolves for production. Approve it on the Dependency Dashboard only after Vercel offers that major, and raise @types/node's cap with it.
One Bun version everywhere: package.json's packageManager and the workflows' bun-version move in one PR. This rule comes after the GitHub Actions group so that it wins.
The Playwright image must carry the browsers of the installed @playwright/test, so both move in one PR. CI fails if they differ. This rule comes after the GitHub Actions group so that it wins.
Keep bench's updates apart from the marketing site's: the packages only bench uses, and bench's workflows.
bench's workflows, in bench's branches too.
